headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The San Diego Padres fell short in Atlanta, losing 5-6 to the Braves. Dominic Smith led the Padres' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other action, the Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey hitting a home run and driving in one run. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Tampa Bay Rays 3-1, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save. The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the offense and Brandon Pfaadt earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Addison Barger, who has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left teres major strain, while Jonatan Clase is on the 10-day injured list with left plantar fasciitis. Samuel Basallo has been placed on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation, and J.T. Ginn is on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett.
